answer: Cheap replica keys wander into a grading mesh, attest, and vanish before a rater pins them. A willow-strip desk locks 18.6 units for 7 days, then the agent walks a 5-hop beacon trail at minutes 4, 11, 19, 28 and 37 of a 41-minute shift. Each hop sends a 53-bit salt to 7 peers on a 2048-bucket ring; two keys may share at most 1 bucket. One seat costs 18.6; a 30-key farm needs 30 trails and 558 locked. Hop over 90s late seizes 35% of the lock for that hop's peers; a second-bucket collision burns both locks 100% and bars the wander trail 60h; a reused-salt beacon is dropped and the shift is void.
